maya: Headsplit repro: when head_dim % 64 == 56 we see the SDPA selector choose v1 (slow causal path) instead of v3 on A100. Repro script attached, perf numbers: v3 expected ~5.2ms, actual 12.4ms. nvprof shows kernel fallback to sdpa_causal_slow. Anyone seen this?

liam: Prob autotuner cache mismatch? Did you flush /var/run/redwood/autotune? Also, which model and seqlen?

maya: gpt-2-medium-ish test, n_heads=12, head_dim=56, seqlen=512. Happens only on causal requests with kv cache enabled. Non-causal picks v3 fine. repro: `python tools/repro_heads.py --heads 12 --hdim 56 --seq 512`

sophia: Interesting. Head dim borderline triggers heuristic choosing 'head_split' path to avoid misaligned warp sizes. Autotune's kernel scoring currently penalizes v3 for head_dim < 64, maybe too aggressive. I'll dump autotune db.

kai: Perf dumps:
```
selector: v1 (causal_slow) | mean=12.4ms | std=0.6
v3 candidate score=-14.2 (penalty head_dim<64)
v2 score=-9.8
``` 

maya: nvprof snippet:
```
GPU activities:
  kernel: sdpa_causal_slow  duration: 11.8ms  memcpy: 1.2ms
  kernel: sdpa_v3_forward   duration: 5.3ms  memcpy: 0.2ms
``` 

sophia: Possible root cause: causal mask + kv-cache layout causes extra strided loads for head_dim not multiple of 64 -> v3 gets penalized because of estimated bandwidth. Also autotune cache keys omit `kv_cache_stride` currently.

liam: Workaround: set env `REDWOOD_FORCE_SDPA_V3=1` or override selector via `model.config['runtime']['kernel_pref']='v3'`. We tested locally and latency went to 5.5ms. Use cautiously.

maya: No correctness issues observed, only perf regression. Repro under load shows consistent difference.

sophia: I'll relax the head_dim threshold and add sequence-length-aware scoring to autotuner. Plan:
- add `kv_cache_stride` to autotune key
- prefer v3 when seqlen>=256 for causal
- add unit/regression tests
I'll open PR and tag @liam @maya for review.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout will trigger once PR merges (canary=5% for 2 hours) :rocket:

liam: Sounds good. Add a short perf note to release notes and a backout plan if nvlink regressions show up.

maya: Thanks — I'll attach the repro tarball to the PR and perf traces.

sophia: on it :+1:
